backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor handling user profiles and booking requests with access control and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Transforms old booking data into the new booking format by adding contact and notes fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing human‑written summaries of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, parent portal, and protected tours page.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing sticky header, navigation bar, footer, and page container.
frontend/src/components/AuthPanel.tsx: Login panel using Internet Identity with retry handling and decorative UI elements.
Interactive calendar for selecting a date and time with month navigation and disabled past dates.
frontend/src/components/BookingConfirmat: Modal displaying booking confirmation details including date, contact info, notes, and booking ID.
frontend/src/components/BubbleCard.tsx: Simple wrapper component applying bubble-style classes based on size.
frontend/src/components/MeetAuntieMaiaPa: Profile panel showcasing Auntie Maia with an image and feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/NannyCamFrame.ts: Frame component showing a nanny-cam video iframe or a placeholder when no feed is available.
Decorative image component with fallback handling and size options.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Gatekeeper component that shows loading, auth panel, or children depending on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/StatusWidgets.ts: Grid of status widgets displaying nap, snack, and play updates with icons and gradients.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingRequests.ts: React-query hooks for creating and listing booking requests via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useParentPortalStatus: Fetches placeholder parent portal status data using react-query once an actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Offers a hook to fetch the current user's profile via an actor, handling loading and fetch state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables, plus utility classes and decorative background rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/ClubhouseHomePage.tsx: Renders the main marketing homepage with hero content, playful decorations, and feature cards.
frontend/src/pages/ParentPortalPage.tsx: Displays authenticated parent portal content including status widgets and a nanny cam feed.
frontend/src/pages/ToursInterviewsBookin: Implements the booking flow for tours and interviews, managing form state, validation, and submission.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, container settings, radii, shadows, and animations, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state for the Auntie Maia MVP, listing required booking-flow fixes, existing features, and pending requests.
